content: Reyansh Tiwari discusses his policy cancellation due to missed payments with agent Suresh Deshmukh. Reyansh questions the reason for cancellation and objects to the extra reinstatement fee, asking for it to be waived. Suresh explains it is a standard fee and offers a payment plan. Reyansh agrees to hear about the payment options but also inquires about the consequences of not reinstating the policy.

action_items: Explain the available payment plan options for policy reinstatement
Explain what happens to the policy if the customer decides not to reinstate
